messages:
Maya G.: FYI Nebula (CFO) pinged — they want to move to a 9-month renewal, request monthly invoices, require vendor code on the invoice, and want Okta SSO appendix visible pre-signature. They're asking if we can do a 7% concession on the 9mo amount. Redline here: https://docsend.example/nebula-renewal-v1
Ibrahim Khalid: Thanks. What's their current ARR and how does 7% impact the invoice? need a quick calc to confirm with the CFO.
Maya G.: Current list ARR = $240k. 9mo pro-rata = $180k. With 7% term concession -> 9mo invoice = $167,400. They prefer monthly billing over 9 months if possible.
Diego M.: Finance note: monthly invoicing ok, but Net45 requires a PO with vendor code and verified billing entity. Without PO we can't extend Net45. Also confirm whether first invoice is prorated or full month.
Rhea S.: I'll confirm with customer whether they need true monthly invoices (i.e., 9 invoices) vs a single invoice split. Which is easier for billing?
Diego M.: Billing prefers a single monthly invoice each month (9 invoices). Also we need the exact vendor code string to avoid mismatches.
Tessa L.: Legal: SSO appendix for Okta is fine as an exhibit. We can publish the DocuSign envelope with the appendix attached. I'll add the exhibit and keep all core T&Cs unchanged. Dropping the SOC language is not recommended.
Ibrahim Khalid: Does a 7% concession need sales manager approval? @Diego M. or @Tessa L. want to weigh in?
Diego M.: Finance prelim approves 7% as a standard term concession on a one-time basis if it's signed this quarter. I'll flag if we need executive signoff but should be OK.
Tessa L.: Legal comfortable with 7% too as long as language on commit and invoice frequency is clear. I'll push redline by EOD.
Maya G.: Customer also asked whether DocuSign can surface the Okta appendix before they sign. Good?
Tessa L.: Yes. DocuSign supports showing exhibits inline. We'll prepare envelope with appendix and a checkbox to confirm SSO contact.
Rhea S.: Sending customer note now: "We can do 9 months with a 7% term concession, monthly invoicing available. Net45 accepted with PO + vendor code. We'll send DocuSign with Okta SSO appendix attached for review prior to signature."
Maya G.: Customer replied: "Agree to 9mo and monthly billing. Vendor code coming from procurement shortly. Will try to route PO today; prefer Net45." :thumbsup:
Ibrahim Khalid: OK, once PO + vendor code received we'll send DocuSign. Diego, please confirm billing workflow then.
Diego M.: Billing to create 9 monthly invoices after PO verification. Please include billing entity: Redwood Inference, Inc. and attach PO to each invoice. CC billing@redwood.example.
Maya G.: Quick PO template they asked us to provide:
```
PO Number: _______
Purchasing Org: Nebula Systems, Inc.
Vendor Code: _______
Billing Entity: Redwood Inference, Inc.
Contract Term: 9 months
Invoice Frequency: Monthly
Payment Terms: Net45
Amount (total): $167,400
Billing Contact: billing@nebula.example
```
Ibrahim Khalid: I'll wait for PO PDF. If they send vendor code, we'll queue DocuSign.
RenewalReminderBot: Reminder scheduled: follow up in 36 hours if PO not received.
Rhea S.: Customer just messaged procurement routed PO to legal@redwood.example, vendor code NBX-992. They asked whether the Okta appendix requires a separate signature line.
Tessa L.: Not necessary; we'll include the appendix and a single signature block. Legal will add a short attestation clause about SSO contacts.
Maya G.: Perfect. I'll upload PO to the envelope and send DocuSign once Tessa confirms redline ready.
Diego M.: Noted. Billing will start invoice schedule after signed DocuSign + PO attached.
Maya G.: Closing loop  marking as in-flight. Will update when DocuSign sent and first invoice queued.
RenewalReminderBot: Thread status -> in_progress. Next reminder in 36h.
